I'll show you a working screen and guide you action by action — please operate it and tell me your thoughts as you go. We'll start with the single most important thing: **saving a link and seeing it appear in your list.** Everything else (search, read-later, archive) we'll layer on afterward.

**First action — let's try the auto-fill.**
In the "Save a link" box at the top, paste this address into the **Web address** field, then click **Get details**:

```
https://github.com/tldr-pages/tldr
```

You should see the **Title** and **Description** fill in on their own.

A few things I decided for this first version — please check whether these feel right, not just whether they work:

- **I made auto-fill happen when you click a "Get details" button**, rather than the instant you paste. My thinking was you might sometimes paste an address and *not* want it to reach out. Tell me if you'd rather it just fill in automatically the moment you paste.
- **I chose these fields for a saved link:** Title, Description, Tags, and a personal Note — with Title and Description being the ones auto-filled and everything freely editable. Let me know if that's the right set, or if something's missing or unwanted.

Once you've clicked **Get details**, tell me what you see — then we'll move on to editing and saving it.
